Trump ends Iran ceasefire, citing 'waste of time'

US President Donald Trump announced the end of a ceasefire with Iran, stating that dealing with them was a "waste of time" and that he would not make a deal. This announcement came after Iran attacked bases hosting US forces. The development led to a nearly 6% jump in oil prices.
